purpose: Loop stability: differential and common-mode loops of a cross-coupled pair

oracle.derivation: Each half is an inverting gain-2 stage plus 0.5 times the other half's input, then the three-pole chain of lstb_three_pole. Differential drive (+1/-1) sees -2+0.5, common mode (+1/+1) -2-0.5: W_dm = 3/(1+jf/1k)^3, W_cm = 5/(1+jf/1k)^3, read on the half circuit. Margins as in lstb_three_pole with DC gains 3 and 5 (GM = 20*log10(8/3), 20*log10(8/5) dB).
